question: Should OpenClaw accept experimental Claw lifecycle diagnostics as a core Doctor contribution and land this PR after the MCP ownership prerequisite?
rationale: The patch adds a new core lifecycle-management surface rather than repairing an established contract, and the current branch is explicitly stacked on another unmerged ownership-model PR.

options.title: Sponsor the staged core design
options.body: Accept the gated Doctor diagnostics as core functionality, fix the gate wording, and land after the MCP ownership prerequisite.

options.title: Keep diagnostics outside core
options.body: Decline the core Doctor contribution and redirect the lifecycle diagnostics to an external package or a narrower future core seam.

options.title: Pause for a smaller core contract
options.body: Ask for the shared ownership model to land first, then reconsider a reduced diagnostic contribution against that stable contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged core design
recommendation.body: Accept the gated Doctor diagnostics as core functionality, fix the gate wording, and land after the MCP ownership prerequisite.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows direct review-routing involvement in this maintainer-labeled experimental stack; exact ownership remains somewhat ambiguous.
